verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Pika exposes its own MCP server for external agents such as ChatGPT and Claude to connect to. That is the server role, and it does not show Pika acting as an MCP client that users can plug third-party MCP servers into. A conversational creative platform could plausibly consume MCP tools, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack documents that capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
